hooks.command: echo 'Post-feature-implementation: if this feature affects user-visible behavior (a new skill, an agent change, a new CLI flag, a new workflow), consider running /docs-review against the changed paths to check whether docs/guide/** needs updates.'

if [ -f .bytewyrd/last-feature-engineer-stop ]; then MTIME=$(stat -c %Y .bytewyrd/last-feature-engineer-stop 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m .bytewyrd/last-feature-engineer-stop 2>/dev/null); if echo "$MTIME" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then SENTINEL_AGE=$(( $(date -u +%s) - $MTIME )); else SENTINEL_AGE=999999; fi; if [ "$SENTINEL_AGE" -lt 86400 ]; then echo 'Post-compact reminder: a feature-engineer agent finished in the last 24 hours and /docs-review may not yet have run. Consider running /docs-review against the implemented files.'; fi; fi

_bw_script="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/check-requirements.sh"; if [ ! -f "$_bw_script" ]; then _bw_script="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/bytewyrd/bytewyrd/scripts/check-requirements.sh"; fi; if [ ! -f "$_bw_script" ]; then _bw_script=$(ls -1 "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/*/bytewyrd/scripts/check-requirements.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n1); fi; if [ -z "$_bw_script" ] || [ ! -f "$_bw_script" ]; then echo 'bytewyrd: check-requirements.sh not found in plugin root or cache; skipping' >&2; exit 0; fi; bash "$_bw_script"
